cleanup_result: Final runtime log records local Worker destruction after the suite. Independent lsof check found no listener on port 19735. No hosted resources were created. limitations_and_next_action: Synthetic legacy SPL-token fixture only; no arbitrary mint ordering, Token-2022, live-provider compatibility, full pricing, signing, simulation, broadcast or economics guarantee. The exploratory bare failure has incomplete source provenance. Initial final-run ENOEXEC was repaired using the same-version verified official executable; cause of cache corruption is not established. Hosted gates and Stage 0 remain open.
